Hi Ana —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive that works for the whole team. High-level takeaways from our discovery:

- Primary use case: patient triage summarization + embedding-based search for care pathways.
- Traffic profile: 20–40k inference requests/day; 95th p95 latency target < 300ms for short-form queries.
- Data concerns: need private deployment option (VPC) + SOC2 evidence.

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep dive (60 min) with your engineering leads and our SE to walk architecture, latency expectations, and integration approach.
2) Share discovery notes and a short runbook (attached) before the call so we can tailor the demo.
3) Agree a repeating demo cadence that rotates time windows so US/EU/APAC stakeholders can attend over successive weeks.

To make scheduling simple, here are three rotating slot templates we can use (we’ll repeat them on a weekly rotation so no one stakeholder is always outside business hours):

- Slot A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — 60 min
- Slot B (EU-friendly): Wed 16:00 BST / 17:00 CEST — 60 min
- Slot C (APAC-friendly): Thu 08:30 SGT / 11:30 AEST — 60 min

If that rotation looks reasonable, please tell me which of those slots your team prefers for the first session and list 2–3 date options over the next three weeks. I can then loop in Soojin (our SE) and send calendar invites. If you prefer a different cadence (e.g., two-week rotation or alternating weeks), happy to adjust.

Calendly link if it’s easier to pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-se/30min?month=2026-09

Attached: 20260918-discovery-notes.pdf (high-level notes), demo-runbook.md (suggested agenda and environment checklist).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
